concern: multi-call composition — two SUBs produce intermediate classifications, main WHEN routes on their product
fidelity_oracle: last BRANCH trace line in the output — must match the main WHEN branch label (sub-routine BRANCH lines appear first and are informational)

cases.rationale: effort_days=8 (>5 → HEAVY) and deadline_days=2 (<=3 → URGENT) → SPLIT
effort_days=8 (>5 → HEAVY) and deadline_days=7 (>3 → NORMAL) → SCHEDULE
effort_days=2 (<=5 → LIGHT) and deadline_days=1 (<=3 → URGENT) → EXPEDITE
effort_days=3 (<=5 → LIGHT) and deadline_days=10 (>3 → NORMAL) → QUEUE
effort_days is a string and deadline_days is negative — the guard must fire before the SUBs are called

effort_days=5 is NOT greater than 5 (strict inequality) → LIGHT; deadline_days=3 IS <=3 → URGENT; combined: EXPEDITE. Model handles strict inequalities correctly at exact boundary values: 5/5 EXPEDITE.

negative_design: the 2×2 capacity×urgency grid yields four mutually distinct verdicts; misclassification in either SUB propagates into the wrong final branch
